dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Has housekeeping cleaned Room 305 yet?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. hæz ˈhaʊskiːpɪŋ ˈkliːnd ˈruːm ˈθriː oʊ ˈfaɪv ˈjɛt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let me check. I'm sorry. They haven't cleaned it yet.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈtʃɛk. aɪm ˈsɑːri. ðeɪ ˈhævənt ˈkliːnd ɪt ˈjɛt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh. When can we go in?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. ˈwɛn kən wiː ˈɡoʊ ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In about thirty minutes. You can wait in the lobby.
dialogue.reading: ɪn əˈbaʊt ˈθɜːrti ˈmɪnɪts. juː kən ˈweɪt ɪn ðə ˈlɑːbi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And my key card doesn't work. Can you check it?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd maɪ ˈkiː ˌkɑːrd ˈdʌzənt ˈwɜːrk. kən juː ˈtʃɛk ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. Here you are. It works now.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈhɪr juː ˈɑːr. ɪt ˈwɜːrks ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, until ten p.m. Have you had lunch yet?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənˈtɪl ˈtɛn ˌpiːˈɛm. hæv juː ˈhæd ˈlʌntʃ ˈjɛt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, not yet. We're very hungry!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. wɪr ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋɡri!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then try the café next to the elevator. The food is very good.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈtraɪ ðə kæˈfeɪ ˈnɛkst tə ði ˈɛləveɪtər. ðə ˈfuːd ɪz ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd.
